paper.title: Combinatorial Multi-armed Bandit with Probabilistically Triggered Arms: A Case with Bounded Regret

settings.name_in_paper: CMAB with probabilistically triggered arms (PTAs), all ATPs positive (arm states in [0,1])
unmapped: every arm is triggered with probability at least p* > 0 by every action (strictly positive arm triggering probabilities)
expected reward function satisfies bounded smoothness with function f (Assumption 1) and monotonicity in the expectation vector (Assumption 2)
regret is (alpha,beta)-approximation regret against an offline (alpha,beta)-approximation oracle, which the learner calls
arm states drawn jointly from an unknown distribution D on [0,1]^m (may be correlated)
settings.definition_quote: There are $m$ arms ... whose states at each epoch are drawn from an unknown joint distribution $D$ with support in $[0,1]^m$. ... $\tau_t$ is drawn from a multivariate distribution ... $D^{\text{trig}}(S_t,\bs{X}^{(t)})$ with support $[p^*,1]^m$ for some $p^* > 0$, which is equivalent to saying that all the ATPs are positive.

settings.name_in_paper: CMAB with PTAs, all ATPs positive, Bernoulli arm states (CTS analysis)
unmapped: every arm is triggered with probability at least p* > 0 by every action
expected reward function satisfies bounded smoothness (Assumption 1) and monotonicity (Assumption 2)
regret is (alpha,beta)-approximation regret against an offline (alpha,beta)-approximation oracle
settings.definition_quote: for CTS, in addition to the assumptions given in Section \ref{sec:problem}, we also assume that $X^{(t)}_i \in \{0,1\}$ for all $i \in \{1,\ldots,m\}$, i.e., the states of the arms are Bernoulli random variables.

algorithms.name: CUCB-kappa (Combinatorial UCB with exploration rate kappa), kappa>0

symbols.nabla_max: largest gap alpha*r* - r(S) among bad actions
symbols.delta_f: f^{-1}(nabla_min/2), f the bounded-smoothness function, nabla_min smallest bad-action gap
symbols.eta_a: free analysis parameter eta in (0,1); bound holds with infimum over eta_a
symbols.t_1: max{4c^2/e^2, 4c_0^2/e^2} with c=1/(p_star(1-eta_a))^2, c_0=6kappa^2/(delta_f^2 eta_a p_star)
symbols.p_star: lower bound on all arm triggering probabilities

conditions: Assumption 1 (bounded smoothness with f) and Assumption 2 (monotonicity)

source.label: thm:finite
source.quote: The regret of CUCB-$\kappa$, $\kappa>0$ is bounded, i.e., $\forall T \geq 1$ \text{Reg}^{\text{CUCB-}\kappa}_{\bs{\mu},\alpha,\beta}(T) \leq  \nabla_{\max} \inf_{\eta \in (0,1)} \bigg(\lceil t_1 \rceil + \frac{m\pi^2}{3} \left(\frac{2}{\delta^2}+\frac{3}{2} \right) + 2m \left(1+\frac{2}{\delta^2\eta p^*} \right)\bigg) where $\delta := f^{-1}(\nabla_{\min}/2 )$ ...

results.notes: Regret is (alpha,beta)-approximation regret T*alpha*beta*r* - E[sum r(S_t)]. Expression is for a fixed eta; paper takes infimum over eta in (0,1). Bounded (constant in T). Uses an (alpha,beta)-approximation oracle.

symbols.nabla_max: largest gap alpha*r* - r(S) among bad actions
symbols.eta_a: free analysis parameter eta in (0,1); infimum taken over it
symbols.p_star: lower bound on all arm triggering probabilities

source.label: thm:finite
source.quote: The regret of CUCB-$0$ is bounded, i.e., $\forall T \geq 1$ \text{Reg}_{\bs{\mu},\alpha,\beta}^{\text{CUCB-}0}(T)\leq  \nabla_{\max} \inf_{\eta \in (0,1) } \bigg(\lceil t' \rceil + \frac{m\pi^2}{3}\left(1+\frac{1}{2\delta^2} \right) + 2m \left(1+\frac{1}{2\delta^2\eta p^*}\right)\bigg) where $\delta := f^{-1}(\nabla_{\min}/2 )$, $t' := 4c^2/e^2$ and $c := 1/(p^*(1-\eta))^2$.

results.notes: t' = 4c^2/e^2 with c = 1/(p*(1-eta))^2 inlined. Infimum over eta omitted from expression.

symbols.nabla_max: largest gap among bad actions (bounded by max reward)
symbols.w: exponent omega in (0,1] of bounded-smoothness function
symbols.eta_a: free analysis parameter in (0,1); infimum over it

conditions: bounded-smoothness function f(x) = gamma x^w with gamma > 0, w in (0,1]

source.label: thm:gap-ind
source.quote: When the bounded-smoothness function in Assumption 1 is $f(x)=\gamma x^w$ where $\gamma >0$ and $\omega \in (0,1]$, the gap-independent regret bound for CUCB-$0$ is ... Hence, the gap-independent regret of CUCB-$0$ is $O(T^{1-\frac{w}{2}})$.

results.notes: Gives O(T^{1-w/2}); O(sqrt T) for w=1 (e.g. OIM). Still depends on p* and nabla_max.

symbols.eta_a: free analysis parameter in (0,1); infimum over it

source.label: thm:finite2
source.quote: The regret of CTS is bounded, i.e., $\forall T \geq 1$ ... \leq \nabla_{\max} \inf_{\eta \in (0,1)} \left(\lceil t' \rceil + \frac{(3+e^{2\delta})m\pi^2}{6} \left(1+\frac{2}{\delta^2}\right) + (3+e^{2\delta}) m \left(1+\frac{2}{\delta^2\eta p^*}\right) \right). where $\delta := f^{-1}(\nabla_{\min}/2 )$, $t' := 4c^2/e^2$ and $c := 1/(p^*(1-\eta))^2$.

results.notes: Infimum over eta omitted from expression.

symbols.eta_a: free analysis parameter in (0,1); infimum over it

conditions: bounded-smoothness function f(x) = gamma x^w with gamma > 0, w in (0,1]

source.label: thm:gap-ind2
source.quote: When the bounded-smoothness function in Assumption 1 is $f(x)=\gamma x^w$ where $\gamma >0$ and $\omega \in (0,1]$, the gap-independent regret bound for CTS is ... Hence, the gap-independent regret of CTS is $O(T^{1-\frac{w}{2}})$.
